hero.description: NYTI provides accessible online and offline training programs designed to help youth develop practical skills, earn recognized certifications, and prepare for better career opportunities.

explore.title: Explore Our Training Programs
explore.description: Search across 100+ programmes in twelve career fields, delivered online and at authorized training centers nationwide.

featured.title: Popular Training Programs
featured.description: Career-focused programmes chosen by thousands of learners, each leading to an NYTI-certified certificate.

modes.title: Online or in the classroom — the same NYTI standard
modes.description: Every programme leads to the same certification, whichever way you choose to learn.

certification.title: How NYTI Certification Works
certification.description: A transparent, standards-based path from enrolment to a certificate that anyone can verify.

steps.title: Choose a Course
steps.body: Select an online or offline training program.

steps.title: Complete Training
steps.body: Attend classes, complete lessons and required activities.

steps.title: Complete Assessment
steps.body: Take the required examination or practical assessment.

steps.title: Receive Your Certificate
steps.body: Successfully completing the requirements allows the learner to receive an NYTI-certified certificate.
